name: stm32-fw-codegen
description: STM32 embedded firmware code generation team: from schematic/netlist to compilable FreeRTOS projects, with driver templates, RTOS architecture, safety review and on-board verification.

displayName.zh: STM32 固件代码生成专家团

profession.zh: STM32 固件代码生成专家团

displayDescription.en: Turns schematics and netlists into compilable STM32 + FreeRTOS firmware: peripheral models, Jinja2 driver templates, RTOS/state-machine architecture, MISRA-C safety review and on-board OTA verification.
displayDescription.zh: 从原理图生成可编译 STM32+FreeRTOS 固件：驱动模板、RTOS 架构、安全审查与上板验证

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一个 STM32 板子（附原理图/网表），帮我生成一版可编译的 FreeRTOS 固件工程骨架，并把引脚、外设和任务都配置好。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have an STM32 board (schematic/netlist attached). Generate a compilable FreeRTOS firmware project skeleton with pins, peripherals and tasks configured.

quickPrompts.zh: 我有一个 STM32 板子（附原理图/网表），帮我生成一版可编译的 FreeRTOS 固件工程骨架，并把引脚、外设和任务都配置好。
quickPrompts.en: I have an STM32 board (schematic/netlist attached). Generate a compilable FreeRTOS firmware project skeleton with pins, peripherals and tasks configured.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我为一块新的 SPI Flash（或 IMU、温压传感器）写一套驱动模板 + 器件模型 + 主机侧单元测试，接入代码生成管线。
quickPrompts.en: Write a full driver template set (model YAML + C template + host unit test) for a new SPI flash / IMU / pressure sensor and wire it into the code generation pipeline.

quickPrompts.zh: 审查这份生成的固件源码：RTOS 任务划分、ISR 共享数据、中断标志清除、失效安全路径与 MISRA C:2012 合规性。
quickPrompts.en: Review this generated firmware source: RTOS task partitioning, ISR shared data, interrupt flag clearing, fail-safe paths and MISRA C:2012 compliance.

profession.zh: 嵌入式安全与 MISRA-C 审查员
构建烧录与 OTA 验证工程师
